product_metadata.title: Air Fryer Liners, 100-Pack 8-Inch Perforated Steam Paper, 8-in Bamboo Steamer Paper Liners
features: BULK AIR FRYER PARCHMENT PAPER: Includes 100 parchment paper liners for air fryer and bamboo steamers.
NON-STICK PAPER: Made of silicone coated parchment paper with perforated holes to keep your bamboo steamer and air fryer free from food residue.
FOOD-SAFE: Parchment paper material is non-toxic and BPA-free, ideal for use with food preparation.
HEAT RESISTANT: Air fryer liners are heat resistant up to 482 degrees Fahrenheit (250 degrees Celsius).

description: MATICAN’s Air Fryer and Bamboo Steamer Liners

MATICAN's perforated parchment paper liners are a must-have for your food preparation needs! Ideal for professional chefs and home cooks alike, these liners are pre-cut with perforations that allow air to circulate through them, which helps food crisp better or steam without sticking to your air fryer basket or steamer basket while evenly cooking your food.
Air Fryer Parchment Sheet Helps Food From Sticking and More

These parchment sheets are a game-changer for your air fryer! If you have a wire air fryer basket or air fryer oven racks, you've probably had issues with sticking. No matter how much oil you spray, some foods will still stick to the wire surfaces. By using these parchment paper you'll have much less sticking and crumbling of even the most delicate foods like fish. They come in handy for easy cleaning too!
Reasons to Use Perforated Parchment Sheets:
